10_taxonomy_evidence.claim: the Atomic/Decision split is an operational distinction consistent with the claim texts, not a demonstrated editorial intent
10_taxonomy_evidence.result: 0 of the 23 Atomic-only comparisons contain one; the Comparison decision controls do
10_taxonomy_evidence.screen: a claim body containing a conclusion verb (conclud|show|demonstrat|outperform|leads|is better|finds that|indicat)
10_taxonomy_evidence.screen_is_not_a_reclassifier: the conclusion-verb screen detects a possible label omission. It never reclassifies. A correction requires a codebook violation that the source text establishes deterministically; otherwise the frozen population does not move.
10_taxonomy_evidence.worked_example: CMP-040's source records only Figure 4 labels of 19.3% at k=1 and 33.3% at k=8. The register's Direction column summarises this as 'Higher observed coverage with larger k'. That sentence is the compiler's, not the source's.

11_specification_drift.prior_outputs: anything computed on 37 or 39 is reported only as an audit of the retired rule
11_specification_drift.reporting: disclosed in the body as researcher specification drift, distinct from RQ3 protocol instability

12_reporting.cluster_caution: effective independence is closer to 4 than to 20. Report per-paper numerators and denominators, treat leave-one-paper-out as descriptive sensitivity rather than a test, and do not generalise to coding-agent evaluation at large.

13_paper_structure: Part I is the published-evidence transfer audit. Part II, if run, is a new-execution protocol-sensitivity study on reconstructed source-like conditions. They share no denominator, estimand, vocabulary or conclusion, and Part II never resolves Part I's states.
2_gate: RQ1 population = an ACTIVE comparison object holding at least one CLM of type 'Comparison decision' in the frozen evidence register. The Direction column is not used for eligibility and is retained only as a consistency check.

3_population_names.retired_name: ACTIVE categorical decision — withdrawn, it implied a source decision that 23 of the 43 do not carry
3_population_names.rq1_population: ACTIVE comparison objects holding at least one source-registered Comparison decision claim (20)

7_eligibility_is_not_attemptability: the two are separate gates. CMP-035 holds a source decision but its reproduction depends on the source's item-level human ratings. Its state is PENDING-AVAILABILITY, not NOT ATTEMPTABLE: the no-human-coding rule forbids us producing new ratings, not reusing ratings the source already recorded if the artifact carries them. If the audit finds only the aggregate 51/78 and no item-level bytes, the state resolves per context — NOT ATTEMPTABLE for RQ1 execution, INAPPLICABLE for RQ2 identical-evidence transfer. One state does not stand in for the other.

8_version_status.observation: every one of the 20 carries Version: NR
8_version_status.wording: Version: NR opens the availability audit; it is not an INAPPLICABLE verdict. Before PREREG-AVAIL-001 completes, all 20 are applicability-undetermined. INAPPLICABLE is a terminal state reached after the audit and the compatibility judgement, and the phrase 'provisionally INAPPLICABLE' is withdrawn.

9_note: recovering every required item and binding it to the source identity admits a CMP to the compatibility judgement. APPLICABLE is confirmed only after that judgement. Availability is necessary, never sufficient.
9_ordered_procedure: freeze the required-item vector for each CMP
assign the six PREREG-AVAIL-001 item states
confirm the complete byte closure and its source-bound immutable identity
judge task frame, evaluator, aggregation, multiplicity, cluster and weight compatibility
execute the transfer only for a CMP that passed the previous step
decided_by: three-axis debate (Claude sub-agent, Codex CLI, ChatGPT-Pro); converged after the claim-type evidence overturned every earlier count

supersedes.why: v1 gated on the register's Direction column, which is the compiler's summary of a comparison, not a record of a source decision
